criteria.name: GO001
criteria.description:
从GSA原始网页定位真实费率或M&IE文件引用，且说明其在预算中的用途。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: The conference_budget.xlsx Sources sheet explicitly locates the real GSA webpage reference (gsa_per_diem_files.html) with the exact locator 'FY 26 Per Diem Rates [XLSX - 41 KB]' and URL https://www.gsa.gov/system/files/FY2026_PerDiemMasterRatesFile.xlsx, which matches the actual link in the input HTML. criteria.name: GO002
criteria.description:
三城市逐日按县、季节、FY2025/FY2026正确匹配费率，提供两年原表行号。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning:
Criterion GO002 requires: (1) three cities with daily rate matching by county and season, (2) correct FY2025/FY2026 mapping, and (3) original table row numbers for both years.

Verification:
- Chicago: FY2025 (Sep 28-30) → row 258 (Cook/Lake, Sep 1-Sep 30, lodging 223, M&IE 92); FY2026 (Oct 1-2) → row 254 (Cook/Lake, Oct 1-Nov 30, lodging 223, M&IE 92). Matches source files exactly.
- Denver: FY2025 (Sep 28-30) → row 109 (Denver/Adams/Arapahoe/Jefferson, Apr 1-Sep 30, lodging 215, M&IE 92); FY2026 (Oct 1-2) → row 107 (same county, Oct 1-Oct 31, lodging 215, M&IE 92). Matches source files exactly.
- Phoenix: FY2025 (Sep 28-30) → row 22 (Maricopa, Sep 1-Sep 30, lodging 160, M&IE 86); FY2026 (Oct 1-2) → row 18 (Maricopa, Oct 1-Jan 31, lodging 160, M&IE 86). Matches source files exactly.

Row numbers are provided in the Daily sheet's `excel_row` column and in the Sources sheet (listing rows per city per FY). The approval_brief.docx references "原表行号见Daily/Sources". All three deliverables are consistent. Season/county matching is correct for all 15 daily entries.

criteria.name: GO003

criteria.name: GO004
criteria.description:

Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: conference_budget.xlsx Daily sheet correctly applies the rule: first/last days use travel_factor=0.75 (MIE_full*0.75 minus full meal deduction, with incidental floor=5 preserved), and other days use factor=1.0 with correct meal deduction. Verified all 15 rows. The approval_brief.docx explicitly cites 301-11.101 (75% first/last day) and 301-11.18 (deduct full meal after reduction, incidental floor preserved). Register references per-diem and meal records as evidence. All three deliverables are consistent with the rule.

criteria.name: GO005
criteria.description:
酒店免费早餐及茶歇不误扣；政府供餐日期和餐别全部使用。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: In conference_budget.xlsx Daily sheet, hotel_breakfast_deduction=0 and refreshment_deduction=0 across all 15 rows (3 cities × 5 days), so free hotel breakfast and refreshments are not wrongly deducted. The government_meals column correctly captures every government-provided meal from the scenario: 09-28 dinner (welcome), 09-29/09-30/10-01 lunch (included in registration), 10-01 dinner, and 10-02 lunch (departure) — all dates and meal types are used. approval_brief.docx explicitly cites 301-11.17 (free hotel breakfast not deducted) and 301-74.21 (refreshments not deducted), and approval_register.csv lists the corresponding evidence items. All three deliverables are consistent with the criterion.

criteria.name: GO006
criteria.description:
六方案人数、机票、当地交通、注册和固定场地费不重复/遗漏，基础总额准确到分。

Per-person sum (lodging+tax+MIE+air+local+registration) matches, base = attendees×per_person + venue, reserve = 5%, total = base+reserve — all arithmetic consistent to the cent across options. approval_brief.docx and approval_register.csv mirror the same figures. criteria.name: GO007
criteria.description:
5%储备与53000预算正确比较，先人数后成本的选址/人数决定正确。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: The deliverables correctly compute a 5% reserve on top of the base cost (e.g., Phoenix 24: base $48,737.60, reserve $2,436.88 = 5%, total $51,174.48) and compare the total against the $53,000 budget ceiling (headroom $1,825.52). The site/headcount decision correctly prioritizes headcount first—recommending 24 attendees over 18—and then selects Phoenix as the only city whose 24-person total (with 5% reserve) fits under $53,000, since Chicago 24 ($57,367.13) and Denver 24 ($55,385.06) both exceed the budget. The brief and register consistently reflect this people-first, then cost-driven recommendation.

criteria.name: GO008
criteria.description:
机票加20%的六方案压力预算和可执行超限措施正确。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: Verified all six stress scenarios in Options sheet: each applies 20% airfare increase to base (e.g., Chicago 18: +82*18=1476 → 44827.52), then 5% reserve (e.g., 44827.52*1.05=47068.896). All six stress_base, stress_total, and stress_headroom values are arithmetically correct. Only Phoenix-24 exceeds the $53,000 cap under stress ($53,744.88, over by $744.88). The approval_brief.docx provides executable measures: lock airfare, request $744.88 supplemental, or fall back to Phoenix-18 (which under stress is $42,408.66, well within cap). The approval_register.csv includes a dedicated "资金与压力情景" line item with owner/evidence/due/blocks fields consistent with the stress measures. All three deliverables are aligned and correct.

criteria.name: GO009
criteria.description:
解释跨财政年度版本选择及本次实际费率是否变化，不凭版本变化推定涨价。
Inspect output/conference_budget.xlsx, output/approval_brief.docx, output/approval_register.csv.
criteria.reasoning: The deliverables fully satisfy criterion GO009. The conference_budget.xlsx Daily sheet explicitly tracks fiscal year version selection with a `fiscal_year` column (2025 for 9/28-9/30, 2026 for 10/1-10/2) and a `source` column identifying which workbook was used (FY2025 vs FY2026), with specific Excel row locators documented in the Sources sheet. The actual rates (lodging_cap, MIE_full) are identical across both fiscal years for each city (e.g., Chicago: lodging 223, MIE 92; Denver: lodging 215, MIE 92; Phoenix: lodging 160, MIE 86). The approval_brief.docx explicitly states in the "规则和证据" section: "两财政年度在本题三地日期的住宿及M&IE费率未发生变化；不同版本仍须分别匹配" (the lodging and M&IE rates for the three cities did not change across the two fiscal years; different versions still need to be matched separately). This directly explains the version selection rationale and confirms no rate change, without inferring a price increase from the version change. The approval_register.csv provides supporting documentation but the key evidence is in the budget workbook and approval brief.

criteria.name: GO010
criteria.description:
审批登记覆盖授权、住宿安全、采购和资金确认，含角色、证据、期限和阻断状态，不假称已审批。

criteria.reasoning: The approval_register.csv contains five items covering: travel authorization (旅行及报销授权), lodging & fire safety (住宿与消防安全), venue procurement & meal scope (场地采购与供餐范围), funding & stress scenario (资金与压力情景), and actual expense authorization (实际费用授权). The conference_budget.xlsx supports the figures referenced in the funding row (Phoenix 24 with $51,174.48 reserve-inclusive). All elements of GO010 are satisfied.
